executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under high pressure. Server DRAM, DRAM and HBM are currently among the most constrained areas. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply security, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain critical.
